resources.string: M57 redirects supported AI apps and detected Meta AI screens to Lyra, shows a dismissible reminder on YouTube Shorts, and can cover listed websites in supported browser address bars when family browser protection is enabled. While protection is active, its detected App info and accessibility service pages return to M57 for administrator access. Password-protected settings allow temporary maintenance access. Reads app identity, supported browser address bars, screen labels, Settings titles, service descriptions, switch and action IDs, and Shorts player IDs locally. Does not save or send messages, browsing history or video content. Enable only if you agree to this access. Detection depends on the device layout; Android can still revoke this service.
